cd "C:/visual projects/alpha" && ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa -o UserKnownHostsFile=$HOME/.ssh/known_hosts root@89.163.242.211 'cat > /data/tk035/daily.py <<"EOF"
import csv, json, zlib, urllib.request, os, datetime
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from decimal import Decimal
from math import gcd
from functools import reduce
inst = {r["symbol"]: (Decimal(r["tick_size"]), Decimal(r["qty_step"])) for r in csv.DictReader(open("/data/alpha/root/instruments.csv"))}
d0 = datetime.date(2026,1,1); d1 = datetime.date(2026,10,1)
days = [(d0+datetime.timedelta(i)).isoformat() for i in range((d1-d0).days+1)]
S = 10**9
OUT = "/data/tk035/daily.jsonl"
done = set()
if os.path.exists(OUT):
    for l in open(OUT):
        try: j = json.loads(l); done.add((j["s"], j["d"]))
        except Exception: pass
def probe(sym, day):
    url = f"https://quote-saver.bycsi.com/orderbook/linear/{sym}/{day}_{sym}_ob200.data.zip"
    st = "err"
    for _ in range(3):
        try:
            req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"Range": "bytes=0-30000"})
            raw = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=40).read(); st = "ok"; break
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
            st = f"http{e.code}"
            if e.code in (403, 404, 416): break
        except Exception: st = "err"
    if st != "ok": return {"s": sym, "d": day, "st": st}
    try:
        nl = int.from_bytes(raw[26:28], "little"); el = int.from_bytes(raw[28:30], "little")
        txt = zlib.decompressobj(-15).decompress(raw[30+nl+el:])
        line = txt.split(b"\n")[0]
        dd = json.loads(line)["data"]
        ps = sorted({int(Decimal(p)*S) for p, q in dd["b"]+dd["a"]})
        qs = {int(Decimal(q)*S) for p, q in dd["b"]+dd["a"]}; qs.discard(0)
        gp = reduce(gcd, [b-a for a, b in zip(ps, ps[1:])])
        gq = reduce(gcd, qs)
        return {"s": sym, "d": day, "st": "ok", "tick": str(Decimal(gp)/S), "step": str(Decimal(gq)/S), "n": len(ps)}
    except Exception as e:
        return {"s": sym, "d": day, "st": "parse"}
jobs = [(s, d) for s in inst for d in days if (s, d) not in done]
with open(OUT, "a") as f, ThreadPoolExecutor(12) as ex:
    for r in ex.map(lambda j: probe(*j), jobs):
        f.write(json.dumps(r)+"\n"); f.flush()
open("/data/tk035/daily.done", "w").write("done")
EOF
cd /data/tk035 && rm -f daily.done && systemd-run --unit=tk035-daily --nice=10 -p MemoryMax=2G python3 /data/tk035/daily.py >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 20; systemctl is-active tk035-daily; wc -l daily.jsonl; tail -2 daily.jsonl'
